tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside tags, gap between stacked strips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and chips; padding inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Largest gap; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-row-x
tokens.usage: Density: left/right padding of a list row inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-row-x-menu
tokens.usage: Density: left/right padding of an item inside a floating layer (menu, palette, select).

tokens.name: space-row-y
tokens.usage: Density: top/bottom padding of a two-line row (= 2px transparent seam + 6px padding).

tokens.name: space-row-seam
tokens.usage: Density: transparent band at the top and bottom of every clickable row, so adjacent hover/selected fills never touch (4px gap between two fills).

tokens.name: space-icon-gap
tokens.usage: Density: 16px icon or agent slot to the row text.

tokens.name: space-trail-gap
tokens.usage: Density: minimum gap from row text to the value, time or buttons on the right.

tokens.name: space-list-inset
tokens.usage: Density: outer margin between a panel edge and its list rows, so a hover fill never touches the container edge.

tokens.name: space-sec-y
tokens.usage: Density: space above a section head and below its last row; the hairline sits between two sections (text-to-line about 18px, as measured).

tokens.name: space-demo
tokens.usage: Density: gap between stacked demo blocks and page blocks; caption to its demo is at least 12.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, kbd, menu items, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, thread rows, strips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, composer, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the thin meter only. Not a fourth step for controls.

shadow.note: One tier, for floating layers only. Panels, rows and buttons carry no shadow; they use a 1px border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menu, popover, command palette, hover card, tooltip, toast, dialog, drawer.

size.note: Control and row heights, all multiples of 4. Density follows the measured rhythm of mainstream desktop developer tools: clickable one-line rows 32, data-only rows 24, two-line rows 52, section heads 32.

tokens.name: ctrl-2xs
tokens.usage: Category tags, count badges, kbd keycaps. Never a click target on its own.

tokens.name: ctrl-xs
tokens.usage: Removable chips, segmented-control items, icon buttons inside rows.

tokens.name: ctrl-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons in rows, detail rows in panels.

tokens.name: ctrl
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select, menu item, panel section head.

tokens.name: ctrl-lg
tokens.usage: Large button, status strip, toast, touch targets on phones.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: One-line list row, the default for long lists (最近, 工作区): agent slot + title + time. Also the details-panel row: icon + 14px label + value.

tokens.name: row-2
tokens.usage: Two-line row (ChangeRow, 等你处理 thread rows, expanded TaskRow, menu items with a description): 8 + 14/20 title + 12/16 second line + 8. Measured pitch in mainstream desktop developer tools is 50.

tokens.name: bp-composer-foot
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the composer footer variant keeps only the agent slot of the model picker and folds effort + permission mode into a ⋯ menu.

tokens.name: bp-composer-account
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the standard composer drops "· 本机账号" from the model picker.

tokens.name: bp-composer-icon
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the standard composer model picker shows only the agent slot and chevron.

tokens.name: bp-batch
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the thread batch bar keeps 已选 N 项 + 归档 and folds 移到分组 / 删除 into ⋯.

tokens.name: row-data
tokens.usage: Data-only row that is not clickable: context breakdown lines, items inside an expanded group. Anything clickable is at least row-1 (32).

tokens.name: row-3
tokens.usage: Three-line result row (command palette): 2 seam + 8 + 20 title + 16 summary + 16 meta + 8 + 2 seam.

tokens.name: row-table
tokens.usage: Table body row (`.fa-table td`): 40, a spec of its own. A table row carries several aligned columns of numbers that are read across, so it gets more height than a list row (row-1, 32). The header row stays ctrl (32). Not used outside tables.

tokens.name: bw-1
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: bw-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness.

duration.note: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all of these to reducedMotion; tokens.css carries that rule, so every transition that takes its duration from a token follows.
